title: 5V thick-oxide mirror device operating point (nfet_g5v0d10v5 / pfet_g5v0d10v5)
claim: Issue #4 -- sweeps the BSIM operating point (Id, Vth, Vov=Vgs-Vth, gm/Id) of diode-connected sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 and sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 at two mirror-device sizes (A: W=4/L=1um, area 4um^2; B: W=8/L=2um, area 16um^2, 4x A) and three bias currents (2/5/20 uA, spanning the per-branch range implied by a <50uA total Iq bandgap core) across process/temperature. Combined with the PDK's own static Vth-mismatch (AVT) coefficients (sw_mm_vth0_sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 / __pfet_g5v0d10v5 in continuous/models_global.spice -- the PDK models expose no separate beta/mobility mismatch term for this device family, only Vth0), this gives an analytic dId/Id-vs-Vov mismatch projection (dId/Id ~= (gm/Id)*sigma_Vth) reported in design/device-characterization-summary.md, and picks the recommended mirror operating region. Supply axis intentionally fixed at nominal 3.30V: all devices are diode-connected and biased by ideal DC current sources with no supply-referenced terminal in the DUT.
statistical_convention: N/A for the corner-matrix operating-point sweep above (deterministic, MC_MM_SWITCH=0). The dId/Id mismatch figure reported in the summary record is an analytic Pelgrom-style projection from the PDK's static AVT coefficient, not a simulated Monte Carlo distribution -- see the summary for the method and its limitations (only Vth mismatch is modeled by the PDK for this device family).
